18 Dresden hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. One snapshot on October 1, 2026 for Nov 5 to Nov 7, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Dresden hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Dresden hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, Traveluro at 2, Agoda at 1, Amimir.com at 1, Barcelo.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Steigenberger Hotel de Saxe at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. These are the Dresden rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 15 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. At the other 3, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Dresden hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Barceló Dresden Newa to 15% at Restaurant & Pension Dresdner Panorama. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
